body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: a16425aa4eb6b500e36d906e42d4d846f40a04b7 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the case adds geometry and posted G-code.
I used the laws from upstream/main at ab9955105d00023351562f2a2865f6e7b6247673.
The local trial merge reported that this main was already included.

What looks good:

- The case meets the layout and operation requirements of #2862.
- The script uses commands, embeds the mesh, and requires verification before posting.
- I read all 297 lines of the new NC golden. No existing golden changes.
- The program has four bolt-circle G81 cycles, one tap-drill cycle, bore and circular arcs, and three thread passes.
- The README states the clearance limits, absent holders, and separate Circular defect #2898.
- No product source, UI, dependency, or process file changes.

Local results:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The full `example_catalog` suite passed all 4 tests.
- The suite regenerated and verified each project. It also rebuilt each script and compared the NC bytes.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: passed for all 3 cases.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passed. The worktree has no tracked changes after the checks.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected no heavy lane.

Extra suites run:

- I searched the test sources for readers of `examples/catalog`.
- `example_catalog`: all 4 tests passed in the quick gate.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: 1 passed, 1 ignored.
- The ignored test exports off-screen screenshots. No screenshot export ran.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changes. The extra kernel STEP and importer checks do not apply.

Mutations repeated locally:

1. Replace G81 with G80 in the new NC file: red, exit 101, with `missing bolt-circle drilling cycle at X0. Y30.`. Restore: green.
2. Flatten the thread G03 Z coordinates to Z8: red, exit 101, with `thread entry rises a quarter pitch`. Restore: green.

Both restored runs passed `hole_work_case_posts_drilling_cycles_and_thread_helix`.
All mutation edits were local and restored. No source code changed.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: No machine, control simulator, Windows, or macOS check ran. This review does not qualify the program for a machine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Merge class: SAME (no commit after the reviewed head). This merge relies on the review by mkinney with the marker for head `a16425aa4eb6b500e36d906e42d4d846f40a04b7`.
